summary.goal: Provide approval UI that reflects the gravity of signing off on a plan
summary.context: Approval is ceremony - not just clicking a button. UI shows exactly what's being approved, makes the commitment explicit, records accountability, and makes immutability clear.

acceptance_criteria.description: Approve button visible on submitted plans for approvers
Clicking opens approval dialog with full context
Dialog shows: plan title, version, step count, scope count, gates
Dialog explains: locks version, records approval, enables publishing
Approver must confirm with explicit action
After approval, plan shows locked state clearly
Approval record shows who approved and when
Edit attempts on approved version show clear message

steps.title: Add Approve button to plan toolbar
steps.description: Approve button visible on submitted plans. Only visible to users with approval permission.

steps.title: Create ApprovalCeremonyDialog
steps.description: Full-screen or prominent dialog showing everything being approved.

acceptance_criteria.description: Shows scope count and step count
Shows gates that will require approval

steps.title: Add commitment explanation section
steps.description: Section explaining: locks version, records approval, enables publishing.

acceptance_criteria.description: Clear bullet points of what happens

steps.title: Implement explicit confirm action
steps.description: Require typing 'APPROVE' or clicking prominent button to confirm.

steps.title: Call approve API and update state
steps.description: Submit approval to API, update plan to locked state on success.

steps.title: Display locked state in UI
steps.description: Approved plans show clear locked indicator. Approval info visible.

steps.title: Block editing on approved plans
steps.description: Edit actions disabled on approved plans with clear message.
